svg.title: Timeline 2014 to 2026
svg.desc: 2014: First Minecraft servers, aged 11; 2016: Learned to code from YouTube; 2017: Founded the PlayGS network; 2021: First certificates; 2023: PHP, Laravel, Linux, volunteer CMO; 2024: NodCord and the UplyTech API; 2025: VectoBeat and new UplyTech site; 2026: Started Tellersonne
